text:
maria: FYI customer Saturn reporting repeated 5xx + timeouts from hosted gateway. Seeing elevated request_queue length and tail p99.

 tj: I'm on it. Which tenant?

 maria: tenant=saturn-analytics. Customer saw 502/504, p99 > 8s starting ~10:12 UTC.

 samir: Metrics: request_queue_length hit 1024 (queue_depth_limit) at 10:12; continuous_batching backlog increased. ops-bot alerted.

 ops-bot: ALERT: hosted.gateway.queue.length saturn-analytics > 1000 for 3m

 jay: Logs show "early_reject: queue_full" then 502. Snippet:
```
ERROR 10:12:23 request_handler.cpp: enqueue failed: queue_depth=1024 limit=1024 tenant=saturn-analytics
```

 tj: any deploys?

 anita: no gateway deploys in past 2h. Model quant changes earlier but not gateway.

 maria: Support provided repro: mixture of small concurrency + few very long-context requests. Can we reproduce?

 tj: trying locally with hey:
```
hey -n 2000 -c 200 -H "Authorization: Bearer x" http://hosted.api/.../v1/complete
```
Queue climbs, tail p99 rises, 504s when queue hit limit.

 samir: Hypothesis: continuous batching backlog due to few long requests (large sequence lengths ~32k) holding batchers; queue_depth per-shard default 1024; max_batch_delay_ms=50 allowed accumulation.

 anita: Also saw request-limiter tokens drained because client retries without backoff.

 maria: Mitigation options?

 jay: Short-term: enable tenant-level early-reject + per-tenant concurrency cap, or reduce max_batch_delay_ms to 10ms to flush faster.

 tj: Applying tenant early-reject and set rate-limit 100rps now.

 ops-bot: RUNBOOK: applying tenant early_reject -> toggling tenant_overrides/saturn-analytics/early_reject=true

 tj: applied override. queue length dropped to ~200.

 support-bot: Notified customer: "We've applied emergency throttling to protect the platform. Please reduce concurrency; will follow up."

 maria: Postmortem and long-term fixes: alert on continuous_batching backlog >200ms; consider dynamic batching window; expose tenant throttle config in Console.

 anita: Also: prevent single large-context requests from blocking batchers — consider split-based processing or preemptive KV-cache eviction.

 samir: Follow-ups: 1) tenant throttle in Console 2) alert for queue_depth > 800 3) infra test simulating mixed-size sequences.

 jay: I'll own alerting infra change. tj: write runbook for early-reject toggle. anita: work on adaptive batching heuristics.

 maria: Timeline: 10:12 incident start -> 10:18 tenant throttle -> 10:26 autoscale -> 10:40 p99 normalized. Customer impacted ~8min of errors.

 tj: logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:22Z WARN request_queue.cpp: backlog_ms=312 tenant=saturn-analytics avg_batch_wait=342
2026-03-15T10:12:23Z ERROR request_handler.cpp: enqueue failed: queue_full
2026-03-15T10:12:24Z INFO tenant_policy.cpp: early_reject enabled for saturn-analytics
```

 maria: Mark incident P1 & assign postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-sre.

 tj: oncall notes: lower max_batch_delay_ms to 10ms for hosted gateway short-term; implement request depth shaper to damp retries.

 samir: Repro script:
```
# repro.sh
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"<long context...>"}' http://hosted.api/v1/complete & done; wait
```

 maria: Support: discuss SLO credit with billing. Closing alert; keep channel open for regressions. Thanks.
